facts.fact: Business Day reports that Equinix opened a R3bn facility east of Johannesburg in October 2024, its first in South Africa.
Business Day reports that Vantage Data Centres opened its first South African unit in the Waterfall precinct in 2022.

note: The 55 data centres built figure is a presidential claim without hire or tier detail; Visa's centre is owner use. Cloud hyperscalers named without a stated live region.
